anyOf.description:
The truncation strategy to use for the model response.
- `auto`: If the input to this Response exceeds
  the model's context window size, the model will truncate the
  response to fit the context window by dropping items from the beginning of the conversation.
  On some models, trimming can begin earlier because the API subtracts the model's
  maximum output allowance from its input limit, even if you set a lower `max_output_tokens`.
- `disabled` (default): If the input size will exceed the context window
  size for a model, the request will fail with a 400 error.

object.description: The object type of this resource - always set to `response`.

status.description:
The status of the response generation. One of `completed`, `failed`,
`in_progress`, `cancelled`, `queued`, or `incomplete`.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when this Response was created.

anyOf.description:
Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when this Response was completed.
Only present when the status is `completed`.
Details about why the response is incomplete.

reason.description:
The reason why the response is incomplete. `steered` means
the response stopped at a safe output boundary after a
WebSocket `response.steer` event. The server can then create
a successor response automatically with the queued input.

input_transformations.description: Reasoning inputs withheld from the model, in input order.

output.description:
An array of content items generated by the model.

- The length and order of items in the `output` array is dependent
  on the model's response.
- Rather than accessing the first item in the `output` array and
  assuming it's an `assistant` message with the content generated by
  the model, you might consider using the `output_text` property where
  supported in SDKs.

anyOf.description:
A system (or developer) message inserted into the model's context.

When using along with `previous_response_id`, the instructions from a previous
response will not be carried over to the next response. This makes it simple
to swap out system (or developer) messages in new responses.

oneOf.description:
A text input to the model, equivalent to a text input with the
`developer` role.

oneOf.title: Input item list
oneOf.description:
A list of one or many input items to the model, containing
different content types.

anyOf.description:
SDK-only convenience property that contains the aggregated text output
from all `output_text` items in the `output` array, if any are present.
Supported in the Python and JavaScript SDKs.

tool_usage.description:
Usage reported by hosted tools, separate from base model `usage`. The field
can be omitted when tool usage is unavailable. When present, tool families
with no recorded usage have zero counts.

`image_gen` sums available token counts across image generation calls.
Calls with missing or incomplete usage records may be skipped. Output
token details and cached input counts can be omitted. An omitted cache
count means cache usage is unknown.

`web_search.num_requests` counts billable searches. Discounted searches
and actions such as opening a page are excluded. Use billing records to
reconcile final charges.

anyOf.description: Moderation results for the response input and output, if moderated completions were requested.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether to allow the model to run tool calls in parallel.

anyOf.description: An upper bound for the number of tokens that can be generated for a response, including visible output tokens and [reasoning tokens](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/reasoning).

content.text: The image depicts a scenic landscape with a wooden boardwalk or pathway leading through lush, green grass under a blue sky with some clouds. The setting suggests a peaceful natural area, possibly a park or nature reserve. There are trees and shrubs in the background.
